purpose: Per-stage retrieval snapshots, timing boundaries and complete candidate rank paths

implementation.storage: successful assistant message in current Streamlit session; no automatic disk persistence
implementation.timing_boundary: Per-stage operation only, excluding extra trace snapshot copies, resource loading, rendering and answer generation. Dense includes query encoding; BM25 includes corpus tokenization and construction.
separate_timings: rerank resource access including cache lookup and load on cache miss
implementation.failure_policy: No new successful trace or partial chat is saved on retrieval, loading, rerank or answer failure.
implementation.citation_limit: Selection means sent as reference, not verified support for a claim.

runs.failure: AppTest dataframe.value conversion to pandas raised AssertionError for pandas.arrays.ArrowStringArray in repeated tests; no app exception. Changed test reader to decode the actual Arrow payload directly; application and dependencies unchanged.

automated_checks.test_models: controlled query vectors, controlled rerank scores and simulated answers; real FAISS, BM25 and Streamlit AppTest

batch contained a set of sentence pairs containing approximately 25000 source tokens and 25000
